page.overview:
Who is Chanyu?

Chanyu was born into the Kiyat tribe, which lived in the rocky wastelands of the Earth Kingdom. He was a spiritual adept for the entirety of his life, and tribal leaders soon learned to trust his warnings of sudden storms and earthquakes.

He began to wield immense power in exchange for the blood of humans. When an entity bestowed this gift on him, he began to appear taller and stronger, yet also hunched and demonic.

He later became the leader of the League of Shattered Skulls, a death cult devoted to Father Glowworm that wished to cause chaos throughout the world. Meanwhile, his brother, Murong, rose to become the Mountain Leader of the Kiyat tribe. Chanyu personally led part of the Shattered Skulls' army to confront one of the leaders of the forces of the four nations.
